name: V_EHI_AUDIT_TAG
description: This view contains audit information for appeal and grievance records for the purpose of EHI export. This view only contains data that applies to all members on a coverage. If not in the EHI context, APPEAL_GRV_AUDIT_TRAIL should be used instead.

columns.name: APPEAL_GRV_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) for the appeal/grievance record.

columns.name: LINE
columns.description: The line number for the information associated with this record. Multiple pieces of information can be associated with this record.

columns.name: AUDIT_TRAIL_INSTANT_UTC_DTTM
columns.description: The date and time that the user changed the item.

columns.name: OLD_VALUE_INTERNAL
columns.description: The value of the item prior to the change.

columns.name: NEW_VALUE_INTERNAL
columns.description: The value the item was changed to.

columns.name: OLD_VALUE_EXTERNAL
columns.description: This item stores the value of the item prior to the change. This column shows the translated external value as of when the the item was changed.

columns.name: NEW_VALUE_EXTERNAL
columns.description: This item stores the value the item was changed to. This column shows the translated external value as of when the item was changed.

columns.name: AUDIT_TRAIL_USER_ID
columns.description: The unique ID associated with the user record who made the change. This column is frequently used to link to the CLARITY_EMP table.

columns.name: AUDIT_TRAIL_USER_ID_NAME
columns.description: The name of the user record. This name may be hidden.

columns.name: CHANGED_DATA_ELEMENT
columns.description: The name of the Clarity table and column corresponding to the changed data.
